title: coax is started again through a restore block like any other program
body:
decade starts coax again on restore through a path of its own. coax's hello carries an `agent` block with its session id and arguments, and `resume_input` in `decade/src/server/children.rs` builds a ghostty that types `coax <args> --session <id>`. decade-15e5eb gives every decade-aware program a general `restore` block for this.

## Proposal

coax sends a `restore` block whose argv carries its arguments and `--session <id>`, with `terminal` true. decade drops `resume_input` and the saved `session` field, and restores coax like any other program. The save file reader keeps an arm that turns an old `session` field into a `restore` block.

## Cost

coax changes in its own repository. decade's save format version goes up again unless this lands with decade-15e5eb.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/5da9dd6b
notes.text: coax's side is coax-5c168a in coax's foam: it sends the restore block after connecting and again when its session changes. decade's side drops resume_input, Children::resuming and the saved session field. The save format moves to 9, since a dev build may have written 8, and the reader turns an old session field into a terminal restore block.
